title: Spot AM Color
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly identify that the bright spot at AM is red.

title: Spot AN Color
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly identify that the bright spot at AN is a mixture of red and violet.

title: Critical Angle Analysis
description: Important Criteria: Student must calculate or compare the critical angles for both colors to determine which undergoes total internal reflection at the curved interface.

title: Refraction at AB
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly apply Snell's law to find the refraction angle for red light at the initial interface AB.

title: Geometry for Distances
description: Important Criteria: Student must use correct geometric relationships (right triangle trigonometry) to relate the refraction angle to the distance AP₁.

title: Final Distance Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly calculate the final distance between the two bright spots as P₁P₂ = AP₁ + AP₂.

title: Sign/Unit Error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the final distance is missing units (cm) or has incorrect units.

title: Total Internal Reflection Misapplication
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly applies the total internal reflection condition (e.g., using the wrong interface or comparing angles incorrectly).
